  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Latent-variable DSEM roadmap}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

The compiler recognizes lavaan-style measurement operators and Mplus-like `BY`
statements. The estimator does not yet fit dynamic CFA, IRT, or latent SEM.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
model <- dsem_model("
  f =~ y1 + y2 + y3
  f ~ lag(f, 1)
", time = "time")
```

Enabling this family requires scale identification, time/person measurement
invariance policy, latent initial conditions, and parity evidence for the public
6.25–6.28 and 9.33–9.37 examples.
